body:
1. Each pet type has 3 tricks. It starts knowing 1.
2. Practise on its training gear in your yard. 5 practice days (one counts per game day) teach the next trick.
3. At the Pet Show it only does tricks it knows. Practised tricks have a bigger gold zone (as decided).
4. Sick pets can't practise.

short: 3 tricks per pet; 5 practice days teach the next

title: How pets learn tricks
